depth.text: shallow angle, thick veins. Mineralization was hosted within the lithologies, not veins. Visible Au was found at a depth of 343.97 m in AU-24-003, with a strong association to anomalous Bi. AU

metallurgy.summary: transitional ore present, sulphide ore, arsenic-bearing; processed by cyanide leach (CIL/CIP), then gravity recovery, then flotation to concentrate, then heap leach; stated recovery Au 93%
